extracted.name: Blue Berry white chocolate brownie
extracted.description: Indulge in the perfect blend of sweet, creamy, and fruity flavors with this Blueberry White Chocolate Brownie recipe! These brownies are soft, fudgy, and loaded with juicy blueberries and chunks of rich white chocolate. Every bite melts in your mouth — a perfect dessert for tea time, parties, or when you just crave something special. It’s an easy and delicious recipe that anyone can make at home!
instruction_lines: Melt white chocolate and butter together until smooth.
In another bowl, whisk eggs, sugar, and vanilla until light and creamy
Add melted chocolate mixture into the egg mixture and mix well.
Sift flour,salt. Fold gently into the batter.
Pour into a lined baking tray.
Cool completely and cut into squares.
